label: Rainy café
prompt: Create a fresh, beautifully composed rainy Japanese neighborhood cafe in refined pixel art. Warm amber pendant light against cool blue rain outside broad dark wooden framed windows, soft sage plaster, walnut wainscot, a quiet terracotta herringbone floor. The fixed room walls should feel like cafe architecture with large rain-streaked windows; no giant brick checkerboard, random speckle, text, fake floor table circles, or floor shadows. EXACTLY THREE physical sound sources with distinct clear animated sprites: a rain-streaked window on the north wall with steady rain on glass (bed), a compact chrome espresso machine standing on the floor in the rear right with continuous steam hiss (bed), and a small porcelain cup and saucer on a compact pedestal near the left perimeter with one isolated cup clink (event, gaps 12-25 seconds). Cup must be small, not a giant mug. Keep all three visible in the initial view. No speech or music or extra objects. Flat ground, normal full room dimensions. Cohesive detailed material shading, 3-4 shades per material, restrained textures, readable silhouettes, polished highlights. Exactly two beds and one event.
